title: Viewer exports and design overlays - who, what and to whom
question: Who may request the offline viewer package, to which addresses may it be sent, how long may links live, and can a package be rebuilt after new captures? Which overlay formats on the drone map and sheet are supported (PDF, shapefile, DXF), who may add them, and is design-overlay-map the governing permission?
context: Drone-map design overlays read a prepared per-structure file with no permission check, and shapefile and DXF overlays are PRD-only (VIEW-REQ-018, VIEW-REQ-019).
